verdict.rationale: Missive's REST API is versioned under https://public.missiveapp.com/v1/. Compatibility changes are flagged inline in the endpoint reference, including a dated WhatsApp breaking-change warning and superseded fields kept as documented legacy aliases. However, the docs explicitly have no versioning or deprecation policy page, so half of the story (a documented deprecation policy) is not delivered. Missing for 10: a published deprecation/versioning policy with timelines and notice periods, evidence of multiple API versions or a migration path, a changelog dedicated to API changes, and independent corroboration.
